digests.summary: Aaj mainly GST ke case law aur e-way bill update par news hai. Sab trade press se hai, koi official notification nahi aaya hai.

items.headline: E-Way Bill enhancements abhi postpone hue
items.detail: GSTN ne 1 August 2026 se jo e-Way Bill system enhance hone wala tha, usko hold pe rakh diya hai. Advisories bhi withdraw kar li hain. Abhi ke liye purana system use karo.
items.cga_view: Koi naya e-way bill compliance abhi apply nahi hoga. Current routine follow karo, jab tak official circular na aaye.

items.headline: Telangana HC: IGST paid, pre-deposit nahi lagega GSTAT appeal mein
items.detail: Telangana HC ne bola ki agar IGST already paid hai, to GSTAT mein appeal karte waqt 10% pre-deposit ki requirement nahi hogi. Issue tha IGST vs CGST/SGST dispute mein.
items.cga_view: Agar similar situation hai to consultant se discuss karo, appeal ke liye yeh precedent use ho sakta hai. Har state ke facts alag ho sakte hain.

items.headline: GST Sec 74: Seized docs ke baad fresh reply allowed
items.detail: Telangana HC ne GST Section 74 matter mein bola ki jab documents seize hon aur later supply ho jayein, to supplementary reply, personal hearing aur adjudication within time allowed hai.
items.cga_view: Agar authorities ne documents supply nahi kiye aur assessment chal raha hai, to fresh reply aur personal hearing ki demand karo. Limitation ka dhyan rakho.
